title: Navotas Music Festival cuts ticket prices ahead of Saturday show
summary: Tickets to the inaugural Navotas Music Festival featuring OPM acts Maki, Cup of Joe and Mayonnaise and P-pop girl group KAIA have been cut to P999 for the festival’s final ticket release.
